title: Decompositions X − P_k = ∂R_k + S_k with vanishing masses imply weak convergence
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be an arbitrary set and let X ∈ D_{m+1}(U). For k ∈ ℕ let P_k, S_k ∈ D_{m+1}(U) and R_k ∈ D_{m+2}(U) (GeometricCurrentOn) satisfy X(ω) − P_k(ω) = ∂R_k(ω) + S_k(ω) for every k and every ω ∈ D^{m+1}(U), where ∂R_k(ω) = R_k(dω). Suppose M(R_k) → 0 and M(S_k) → 0 in [0, ∞] as k → ∞, where M = mass = M_U. Then P_k ⇀ X, i.e. P_k(ω) → X(ω) for every ω ∈ D^{m+1}(U) (WeaklyConvergesOn P_k X).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (Pk S : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (R : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 2)), (∀ (k : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1)), X ω - Pk k ω = (R k).boundary ω + S k ω) → Tendsto (fun k => (R k).mass) atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun k => (S k).mass) atTop (𝓝 0) → WeaklyConvergesOn Pk X
